autoDownload: Okuwanula ebipya ebipya mu ngeri ey'otoma
failedToRelocateDataFolderDesc: Eremereddwa okukyusa ekifo kya data. Nsaba oddemu ogezeeko.
factoryResetDesc: Kino kijja kuzzaawo ensengeka zonna eza app ku zisookerwako. Kino tekiyinza kuddibwamu. Kino tukiteesaako singa app eyonoonese.
documentationDesc: Yiga engeri y'okukozesaamu Novera n'okunoonyereza ku bikozesebwa byayo.
discussionsDesc: Weegatte ku kitundu kyaffe okufuna obuwagizi n'okukubaganya ebirowoozo.
reportAnIssueDesc: Ozudde ekiwuka? Tuyambe nga ossaayo ensonga ku GitHub.
creditsDesc1: Novera (TRON-ABS), nga yesigamiziddwa ku Jan eyakolebwa Menlo Research n’abaagiwaddeyo.
creditsDesc2: Okwebaza okw’enjawulo eri ebifo byaffe ebisinziira ku nsibuko enzigule-naddala llama.cpp ne Tauri-n’ekibiina kyaffe ekyewuunyisa ekya AI.

dataFolder.appDataDesc: Ekifo awateekebwa obubaka, models eziwanuliddwa ne data endala.

others.spellCheckDesc: Ssobozesa okukebera enjawulo ku mikutu gyo.
others.resetFactoryDesc: Okuzzaawo enkola mu mbeera yaayo eyasooka, okusangula models zonna n'ebyafaayo by'emboozi. Ekikolwa kino tekikyusibwa era kisemba singa enkola eyonoonese.

shortcuts.switchAssistantDesc: Cycle okutuuka ku muyambi addako mu mboozi.

interface.subtitle: Novera gifuule eyiyo, okuva ku ndabika yaayo okutuuka ku mboozi gy’oyagala.
interface.accentColorDesc: Londa langi ya accent ne sidebar.
interface.title: Enkolagana
interface.notificationPositionDesc: Awali okumanyisibwa kwa toast we kulabika. Ku Windows, ekisookerwako kiri wansi ku ddyo kale ebifuluma tebibikka ku bifuga ddirisa.
interface.showTokenSpeedDesc: Laga obubonero/sec n'omuwendo gw'obubonero mu layini wansi w'obubaka obuyambi. Bwe kiba kizikiddwa, akabonero akatono kalaga ebikwata ku nsonga eno ku kunyiga.
interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Kozesa langi ya accent nga background y'obubaka bwo. Bwe ziggwaawo, zikwataganya obubaka obuyambi n’ebiwandiiko ebya bulijjo ku mugongo ogutaliimu ludda.
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Yongera ku tabu ya Preview ku HTML ne SVG code blocks. HTML eddukanya omuko ogukoleddwa model mu sandboxed frame ekola scripts zaayo naye nga tesobola kuyingira Novera, files zo, oba network; SVG ekola mu ngeri etali ya kukyukakyuka nga scripts ziremeddwa. Off nga bwekiba.
interface.autoGenerateTitle: Okukola omutwe gw'emboozi mu ngeri ey'okwekolako
interface.autoGenerateTitleDesc: Funza emboozi empya mu ngeri ey’otoma mu mutwe gw’oluwuzi. Ggyako okukuuma omutwe ogusookerwako okutuusa lw'ogukyusa erinnya ggwe kennyini.
interface.windowBackgroundDesc: Teeka langi y'emabega w'eddirisa lya app.
interface.appMainViewDesc: Teeka langi y’emabega w’ekitundu ekikulu eky’ebirimu.
interface.primaryDesc: Teeka langi enkulu ku nnyiriri z’enkolagana.
interface.accentDesc: Londa langi ya accent ekozesebwa mu UI yonna.
interface.destructiveDesc: Teeka langi ya highlight ku bikolwa ebizikiriza.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Ddamu okuteekawo ensengeka zonna ez'enkolagana ku default.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: Ensengeka zonna ez'enkolagana zikomezeddwawo nga bwe zaali.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Londa engeri ekifo eky’okulabamu emboozi gye kirina okukolamu ng’obubaka obupya butuuse.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Ekuuma ekifo eky'okulaba nga kinywedde ku bubaka obusembyeyo bw'oweereza.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Egoberera otomatiki ng’eby’okuddamu bikulukuta mu kiseera ekituufu.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Laga ekibala obubonero munda mu kuyingiza emboozi. Bwe kiremeddwa, token counter ejja kulabika wansi w'ekiyingizibwa.
interface.showLineNumbersDesc: Laga ennamba za layini mu bulooka za koodi.
interface.resetCodeBlockStyleDesc: Okuzzaawo sitayiro ya code block ku default.
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccess: Okuzzaawo sitayiro ya bulooka ya koodi bulungi
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: Omusono gwa code block gukomezeddwawo ku default.

hardware.name: Erinnya
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Kozesa Vulkan API okusobola okwanguya GPU. Tosobozesa Vulkan bw'oba olina NVIDIA GPU kuba eyinza okuleeta ensonga z'okukwatagana.
hardware.noDevicesDesc: Tewali GPU zirabika ku yingini ya llama.cpp. Models zijja kutambulira ku CPU.
hardware.backendApiDesc: Engeri llama.cpp gy'eyogera ne GPU eno
hardware.backendSelectDesc: Kozesa API eno ku GPU eno
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: GPU egabana ekifo kimu eky’okujjukira ne CPU — ebika biggya mu jjukira lye limu n’enkola yonna.
hardware.engineRestartedForDevices: GPU zo zakyuka, kale yingini ya wano yaddamu okutandika. Models reload ku nkozesa eddako.
hardware.engineBusyDevicesChanged: GPU zo zakyuka, naye model eri busy. Kiyimirize, olwo onyige Refresh okukozesa GPU empya.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: URL n'omwalo gwa proxy server yo.
httpsProxy.authenticationDesc: Ebiwandiiko ebikakasa seva ya proxy, bwe kiba kyetaagisa.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: Olukalala olwawuddwamu koma olwa host okuyita ku proxy.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Kiriza satifikeeti eziteekeddwako omukono oba ezitakakasiddwa. Kino kiyinza okwetaagisa ku ba proxy abamu naye kikendeeza ku bukuumi. Ssobozesa singa oba weesiga proxy yo yokka.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Kakasa satifikeeti ya SSL nga oyungibwa ku proxy.
httpsProxy.proxyHostSslDesc: Kakasa satifikeeti ya SSL eya host ya proxy.
httpsProxy.peerSslDesc: Okukakasa satifikeeti za SSL ez'okuyungibwa kwa bannaabwe.
httpsProxy.hostSslDesc: Kakasa satifikeeti za SSL eza host ezigenda.

webSearch.title: Okunoonya ku mukutu
webSearch.description: Leka ba models banoonye era basome omukutu nga bakozesa ebikozesebwa Novera ebizimbibwamu.
webSearch.enableDesc: Okulanga ebikozesebwa mu kunoonya web_search ne web_fetch eri models eziwagira enkozesa y'ebikozesebwa. Ekola okuva mu box nga tewali kisumuluzo kya API.
webSearch.providerDesc: Londa backend eddamu web_search ne web_fetch.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Okwesalirawo. Waayo ekisumuluzo kya API {{provider}} ku kkomo ly'emiwendo erya waggulu n'ebivuddemu ebitegekeddwa. Leka nga njereere okukozesa enkomerero etaliiko kisumuluzo ey'obwereere.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Kyetaagisa. {{provider}} yeetaaga ekisumuluzo kya API okuzzaayo ebivuddemu.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Kyetaagisa. URL enkulu ey'ekyokulabirako kyo {{provider}}, nga JSON API ekoleddwa.

cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Tegeka engulu ya agenti wa Cowork: ekisusunku kyayo ekirimu omusenyu, nga kwogasse ebijjukizo n’obukugu ebikuumibwa enkalakkalira mu folda yo eya data ya Novera.
cowork.shellSandboxed: Ebiragiro bidduka nga bisibiddwa {{backend}}: bisobola okuwandiika munda mu kifo ky'okukoleramu olutuula byokka, era fayiro mu folda yo ey'awaka tezisomebwa.
cowork.shellUnavailable: Tewali sandbox eriwo ku nkola eno, kale ekintu ekikozesebwa mu kisusunku tekiweebwa. Ebiragiro tebiddukanyizibwako nga tebiziyiziddwa.
cowork.networkDesc: Leka ebiragiro bya Cowork bituuke ku mutimbagano, ku bintu nga okuteeka packages oba okuleeta etterekero. On nga bwekiba. Shell ya main chat tebangako na network access.
cowork.noMemories: Tewali bijjukizo n'okutuusa kati. Abakozi bazigattako n'ekintu ekiyitibwa memory_write nga bwe bayiga ebintu ebisaanira okukuumibwa.
cowork.noSkills: Tewali bukugu n'okutuusa kati. Obukugu ye ndagiriro eziddamu okukozesebwa model z’esobola okutikka ku bwetaavu.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Omulamwa gumu buli note. Models zisoma bino emabega n'ekintu memory_read.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Ebiragiro by’okussaako akabonero, nga bw’oyagala nga olina ennyonyola mu YAML frontmatter. Ennyonnyola y’ekyo models kye balaba nga tebannatikka bukugu.
cowork.loadFailed: Teyasobodde kutikka kifo kya agenti we bakolera

localApiServer.title: Seva ya API ey’omu kitundu
localApiServer.description: Kozesa seva ekwatagana ne OpenAI mu kitundu.
localApiServer.serverLogsDesc: Laba ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku seva ya API ey'omu kitundu.
localApiServer.swaggerDocsDesc: Laba ebiwandiiko bya API ebikwatagana (Swagger UI).
localApiServer.runOnStartupDesc: Tandika Local API Server mu ngeri ey’otoma nga enkola etongozeddwa.
localApiServer.runInBackgroundDesc: Kuuma server ng’ekola mu system tray nga eddirisa liggaddwa. Bwe kiggwaawo, okuggalawo eddirisa kiva mu Novera ne kiyimiriza seva.
localApiServer.serverPortDesc: Ennamba y'omwalo gwa seva ya API.
localApiServer.apiPrefixDesc: Entandikwa y'ekkubo eri enkomerero za API.
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: Hosts zikkirizibwa okuyingira ku server, nga zaawuddwamu koma.
localApiServer.cors: Okugabana eby’obugagga okuva mu nsi yonna (CORS) .
localApiServer.corsDesc: Kiriza okusaba okusalako ensibuko eri seva ya API.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Ssobozesa ebiwandiiko bya seva ebikwata ku kulongoosa.
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: Ekiseera ky’okulinda okuddibwamu okuva mu model y’omu kitundu, sekondi.
localApiServer.defaultModel: Omuze ogusookerwako Seva ya API ey’omu kitundu
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: Local model okutikka automatically nga server etandise.

privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: Okutuyamba okulongoosa Novera, osobola okugabana data etamanyiddwa nga enkozesa y'ebintu n'okubala abakozesa. Tetukung’aanyangako mboozi zo oba ebikwata ku muntu wo.
privacy.privacyPolicy: Olina obuyinza obujjuvu ku data yo. Manya ebisingawo mu Nkola yaffe ey’Ebyama.
privacy.analyticsDesc: Okulongoosa Novera, twetaaga okutegeera engeri gy’ekozesebwamu —naye nga tuyambibwako bwokka. Osobola okukyusa ensengeka eno essaawa yonna.
privacy.privacyPromises: Okulonda kwo wano tekujja kukyusa bisuubizo byaffe ebikulu eby'ekyama:
privacy.promise1: Emboozi zo zisigala nga za kyama era ku kyuma kyo
privacy.promise2: Tetukung’aanya bikwata ku muntu wo oba ebirimu mu mboozi
privacy.promise3: Okugabana data kwonna tekumanyiddwa mannya era nga kugatta
privacy.promise4: Osobola okuvaamu essaawa yonna nga tofiiriddwa nkola
privacy.promise5: Tuli balambulukufu ku bye tukung'aanya ne lwaki

general.couldNotRelocateToRoot: Tesobola kukyusa folda ya data mu root directory. Nsaba olonde ekifo ekirala.
general.couldNotResetRootDirectory: Tesobola kuzzaawo folda ya data nga eteekeddwa ku root directory. Nsaba osazeewo ekitabo kya data mu ngalo.
general.failedToRelocateDataFolderDesc: Eremereddwa okukyusa ekifo kya data. Nsaba oddemu ogezeeko.
general.autoUpdateCheckDesc: Kebera otomatika oba waliwo ebipya ku kutandika ne buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera.
general.factoryResetDesc: Kino kijja kuzzaawo ensengeka zonna eza app ku zisookerwako. Kino tekiyinza kuddibwamu. Kino tukiteesaako singa app eyonoonese.
general.keepAppDataDesc: Ebyafaayo byo eby'okukubaganya ebirowoozo n'emboozi zo bijja kukuumibwa.
general.keepModelsAndConfigsDesc: Ebika ebiwanuliddwa, ensengeka ya yingini, n’ensengeka za MCP bijja kukuumibwa.
general.clearWebDataDesc: Eggyawo eby'okutereka eby'omu kitundu ebiterekeddwa n'eby'okulonda ebya UI ebikuumibwa eddirisa lya app. Enkolagana edda mu mbeera yaayo eya bulijjo.
general.huggingfaceTokenDesc: Akabonero ko aka HuggingFace API ak'okuyingira mu bikolwa.
general.janCliDesc: Dukanya agent ya Novera okuva ku terminal yo. Goberera ebiragiro okussaako n’okutandika.
general.documentationDesc: Yiga engeri y'okukozesaamu Novera n'okunoonyereza ku bikozesebwa byayo.

attachments.subtitle: Tegeka ebigattibwako ebiwandiiko, ekkomo ku sayizi, n'enneeyisa y'okuggya.
attachments.enableDesc: Kiriza okuteeka n'okuwandiika ebiwandiiko mu index okusobola okubiggyayo.
attachments.parseModeDesc: Londa engeri ebiwandiiko ebisengekeddwa gye byongerwamu mu mboozi.
attachments.autoInlineThreshold: Omusingi gw’okuyingira mu layini mu ngeri ey’obwengula
attachments.autoInlineThresholdDesc: Ekitundu ky’embeera y’ekyokulabirako ekikozesebwa ng’okusalako okuyingiza fayiro ezisengekeddwa ku bikolwa eby’omu kitundu.
attachments.maxFileDisabledReason: Ggyako Enable Attachments okukyusa ekkomo ku sayizi y'ekiwandiiko.
attachments.maxFileDesc: Sayizi esinga obunene buli kiwandiiko. Essibwa mu nkola mu kiseera ky'okuteeka n'okukola. Ebifaananyi birina ekkomo lyabyo waggulu.
attachments.maxImageDesc: Sayizi esinga obunene buli kifaananyi (JPEG oba PNG). Omuwa oba model yo ayinza okussa mu nkola ekkomo erya wansi.
attachments.thresholdDesc: Obukodyo obutono obw’okufaanagana (0-1). Ekozesebwa mu kunoonya kwa linear cosine kwokka, so si ANN.
attachments.searchModeDesc: Londa wakati wa sqlite-vec ANN, linear cosine, oba auto.
attachments.chunkSizeDesc: Ennukuta ezibalirirwamu max buli chunk ku embeddings.

changeDataFolder.title: Kyusa Ekifo kya Data Folder
changeDataFolder.description: Okakasa nti oyagala okukyusa ekifo kya data folder? Kino kijja kutambuza data yo yonna mu kifo ekipya era kiddemu okutandika enkola.
